table.retrieve:
SELECT customer=accounts.name, 
		accalias=accounts.aliasname,
		 customercode=cstatus.acccode, 
		 region = r.name,
		 area = area.name,
		 areacode=area.areacode , 
		 OpeningBalance=cstatus.opbalance, 
		 cstatus.sale, 
		 SaleReturn=cstatus.sreturn, 
		 NetSale=cstatus.sale - cstatus.sreturn, 
		 Recieved=cstatus.recvd, 
		 adgdebit=cstatus.dradj, 
		 adgcredit=cstatus.cradj,
		 ClosingBalance=cstatus.opbalance+(cstatus.sale-cstatus.sreturn)-cstatus.recvd+cstatus.dradj-cstatus.cradj
FROM customer ac, area, accounts, region r, 
(SELECT acccode, sum(opbalance) as opbalance, 
		sum(sale) as sale, 
		sum(sreturn) as sreturn,
		sum(recvd) as recvd, 
		sum(dradj) as dradj, 
		sum(cradj) as cradj
FROM
	(select acccode, opbalance = sum(debit - credit), sale=0, sreturn=0, recvd=0, dradj=0, cradj=0
	from virtualgl
	where date < :ad_sdate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 3)
	group by acccode
	union all
	select acccode, opbalance =0, sale=sum(debit), sreturn=0, recvd=0, dradj=0, cradj=0
	from virtualgl
	where documenttype in ('SV', 'RS') AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 3)
	group by acccode
	union all
	select acccode, opbalance =0, sale=0, sreturn=sum(credit), recvd=0, dradj=0, cradj=0
	from virtualgl
	where documenttype in ('SR', 'RR') AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 3)
	group by acccode
	union all
	select acccode, opbalance =0, sale=0, sreturn=0, recvd=sum(credit-debit), dradj=0, cradj=0
	from virtualgl
	where documenttype in ('CR', 'BR', 'CP', 'BP', 'CRSALE', 'BRSALE', 'CPPUR', 'BPPUR') AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 3)
	group by acccode
	union all
	select acccode=custcode, opbalance =0, sale=0, sreturn=0, recvd=sum(amt), dradj=0, cradj=0
	from saleledger
	where amt <> 0 AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and accountfor='Y' AND Posted='Y'
	group by custcode
	union all
	select acccode, opbalance =0, sale=0, sreturn=0, recvd=0, dradj=sum(debit), cradj=sum(credit)
	from virtualgl
	where documenttype NOT IN ('CR', 'BR', 'CP', 'BP', 'CRSALE', 'BRSALE', 'CPPUR', 'BPPUR', 'SV', 'SR', 'RS', 'RR') AND date >= :ad_sdate and date <= :ad_ldate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 3)
	group by acccode) a
group by a.acccode) cstatus
where r.regioncode IN (:aa_regioncode) and 
		r.regioncode = area.regioncode and
		area.areacode = ac.areacode and 
		ac.custcode = accounts.acccode and 
		accounts.acccode = cstatus.acccode
ORDER BY r.name, area.name, customer, customercode
